user.title: Add a Tuya device
user.description: Choose how you want to add your device. **Search** scans your network automatically — make sure the device is powered on and connected to the same Wi-Fi as Home Assistant.

data_description.setup_mode: Search finds devices automatically. Choose manual if your device is not found.

select.title: Found {count} device(s)
select.description: Select the device you want to add.

local_key.title: Enter the security key
local_key.description:
Your device at **{ip_address}** (firmware {firmware}) requires a security key to communicate locally.

The key is shown when you pair the device using the Tuya Cloudless pairing tool. It is stored only on your Home Assistant instance.

data_description.device_name: A friendly name shown in Home Assistant (optional — defaults to the IP address)
data_description.device_type: Select the closest match — affects which controls are created

confirm.title: Ready to connect
confirm.description:
**{device_name}** at `{ip_address}` will be added to Home Assistant.

Click **Connect** to test the connection and finish setup.

manual.title: Add device manually
manual.description: Enter the details for your Tuya device. The device ID and security key are shown in the Tuya Cloudless pairing tool.

data_description.gw_id: Unique identifier for the device (shown during pairing, e.g. abc123def456)
data_description.local_key: 16-character security key from the pairing tool
data_description.ip_address: Device IP address (set a static address in your router for reliability)
data_description.protocol_version: Generation 3.3 works for most devices made after 2020
data_description.device_type: Select the closest match — affects which controls are created

discovery.title: Tuya device found
discovery.description:
A device was detected at **{ip_address}** (firmware {firmware}).

Enter the security key to complete setup.

data_description.local_key: 16-character key from the Tuya Cloudless pairing tool

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device — check the IP address and that the device is on the same network as Home Assistant
error.invalid_local_key: Invalid security key — must be exactly 16 characters
error.invalid_gw_id: Invalid device ID — must not be empty
error.auth_failed: Connection refused — the security key may be wrong, or the device was re-paired using the Tuya cloud app
error.no_devices_found: No Tuya devices found on your network. Make sure your device is powered on and on the same Wi-Fi. Switch to **Manual** above to enter details by hand.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant log for details

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up
abort.not_tuya_device: The device did not respond as expected

data_description.ip_address: Update if the device IP address changed
data_description.protocol_version: Change only if the device stopped responding after a firmware update
